title: Cactus Jack vs. Triple H: the champion’s ordeal
summary: Mick Foley brings back Cactus Jack to confront Triple H. A street fight escalates into a title-versus-career match inside Hell in a Cell.

chapters.title: Triple H survives the street fight
chapters.result: Triple H defeats Cactus Jack to retain the WWF title.
chapters.context: The violent title match sets up an even higher-stakes rematch.

chapters.title: Cactus Jack loses the career stipulation
chapters.result: Triple H defeats Cactus Jack inside Hell in a Cell.
chapters.context: Foley loses the match carrying a retirement stipulation, although he later returns.
